key_insight: An asymmetrically threaded SQUID (ATS) coupler enables fast entangling gates between Kerr-cat qubits while preserving their protection against bit-flip errors.
engineering_relevance: This design offers a potential building block for concatenated cat-qubit architectures without requiring complex pulse shaping.
method: Use an ATS parametric coupler to mediate a bias-preserving CX gate.
Engineer unequal photon numbers in control and target modes to suppress non-adiabatic leakage.
Evaluate gate fidelity and noise bias through full-circuit Hamiltonian simulations.
evidence_signal: Simulations report 99.69% CX fidelity at 50 ns without photon loss and a noise bias of 9,922 at a 100 kHz single-photon loss rate—about 570 times that of a naive non-bias-preserving CX.
watch_item: Results are simulation-based; experimental validation is needed, and the quoted fidelity excludes photon loss.
paper_title: Bias-Preserving Entanglement of Kerr-Cat Qubits with an ATS Coupler
